topic: Packing a brown-bag work lunch vs buying daily takeout (Callum vs Orla)

scenes.narration: Buying lunch out every workday quietly eats over three thousand dollars a year. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding a takeout bag and a brown lunch bag, comic burst banner reads THREE THOUSAND A YEAR, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Callum and Orla both work downtown near pricey lunch spots.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man callum and woman orla in gym gear near a city window, a wall map labeled PRICEY LUNCH SPOTS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Each used to grab a fourteen dollar takeout lunch daily.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, both callum and orla at a gym snack counter holding takeout boxes stamped FOURTEEN DOLLARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Callum keeps buying burritos, sandwiches, and smoothies every single workday.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, callum on a gym bench surrounded by burritos sandwiches and a smoothie, comic banner reads DAILY TAKEOUT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He says packing his own food takes too much effort.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, callum shrugging by a gym locker beside an empty lunchbox stamped TOO MUCH EFFORT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Orla preps five brown-bag lunches every Sunday evening in advance.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, orla in gym gear lining up five brown lunch bags on a counter, a calendar labeled SUNDAY PREP, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her homemade lunches cost about three dollars each to make.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, orla holding a wrapped homemade sandwich near a gym bench, a price tag stamped THREE DOLLARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: That saves her about eleven dollars for every workday she packs.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, orla tucking a brown bag into a gym duffel, a coin stack labeled ELEVEN SAVED DAILY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: One year later Callum spent three thousand on takeout lunches.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked callum on a gym mat buried in takeout receipts stamped THREE THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Orla spent under seven hundred dollars and banked the difference.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, orla smiling with a small receipt stamped SEVEN HUNDRED and a savings jar labeled DIFFERENCE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She rolled that twenty-three hundred dollars into her emergency fund.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, orla dropping cash into a gym locker jar labeled EMERGENCY FUND, a tag reading TWENTY THREE HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Pack lunches on Sunday and save eleven dollars a day. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing a whistle in the gym holding a clipboard reading SUNDAY MEAL PREP, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
